## Requirements

1. `github-issues` adapter — `work_source_adapter/1.0` ops (`capabilities`,
   `occurrences`, `suspended`, `activate_run`, `list`, `get`) over the GitHub
   Issues REST shapes; packaged plugin variant at `subprocess_confined`;
   hermetic tests over recorded request/response fixtures.
2. Signed ingress — `fleet.webhook_ingress` verifies `X-Hub-Signature-256`
   over the raw body; secret resolved by `key_ref` through the broker;
   delivery-id occurrence keys + replay-window dedupe (CC1 reuse).
3. `scripts/live-github.sh` — ingress listener on loopback; cloudflared quick
   tunnel; hook registered via API; test issue/comment; wait for signed
   delivery; trap-guarded hook delete + issue close.
4. Live legs (`live-verify.sh github-live`) — capability probe, `list`/`get`
   vs sandbox, signed delivery → reconciler → `WorkItem` (dedupe +
   stale-window no-op), out-of-process placement (AC-R-2.12.6-9); evidence
   committed; hook deletion confirmed in the record.
5. DF-S5.6-1 → DONE; row 082 dated note; R-2.12.6 evidence for R4.16.

## Plan

Design (from Phase-0 survey):

- **`hh-fleet/src/github.rs`** (new) — the GitHub dialect half that lives
  with the ingress lane: `GithubConfig` (the `github` member on a
  `hh.fleet.webhook_source/1` doc — `repo`, `source_id`, `external_kind`,
  `owner_map`, `owner_default`, `repo_archived`), `verify_sig256`
  (`X-Hub-Signature-256` = `sha256=<hex>` over the raw body), `event_item`
  (`issues`/`issue_comment` payload → `WorkItemInit` doc; `ping`+others →
  typed refusal), `issue_record` (raw issue → `WorkSourceRecord`), and
  `github_item_id` (`gh-<repo>-<n>`). One canonical mapping (CC1) shared
  by the boundary lane and the plugin.
- **`hh-fleet/src/ingress.rs`** — `receive_github(raw_body, signature,
  delivery_id, event, key, now)` on `SignedWebhookIngress` +
  `WebhookAdapter`; the verify→key→enqueue tail factors into a shared
  `accept` helper (CC1). `WebhookAdapter::from_doc` gains the `github`
  member; a github-lane `receive` without it is `MalformedPayload`.
- **`hh-fleet-adapter/src/github.rs`** (new) — `GithubTracker`:
  `TrackerLogic` over the `hh.fleet.github_source/1` doc (`github{}` +
  `issues[]` raw GitHub issue objects + `occurrences[]`/`suspended[]`/
  `activate_run[]`/`capabilities`/`probe` verbatim members). `list`/`get`
  normalize via `issue_record`; `activate_run` answers open issues;
  `capabilities` declares `push_delivery_id`/`poll`/`assignee_mapping`
  declared + `native_write_tools`/`blocker_metadata` declared_absent.
- **`crates/hh-github-issues`** (new crate) — the packaged variant binary
  mirroring `hh-tracker-fixture` (`github_doc` bind param, `tracker::
  dispatch`); `plugins/hh-github-issues/plugin.manifest.json`.
- **`hh-embed/src/fleet_ops.rs`** — `fleet.webhook_ingress` gains the raw
  lane: `delivery_raw` + `signature` (`sha256=<hex>` verbatim header) +
  `delivery_id`/`event` → `receive_github`. After a successful receive in
  either lane the op now **admits**: `eng.observe` folds the queued
  occurrence into `context.observation.recorded` + `control.wakeup.
  occurred` durably, so the next `fleet.reconcile` turns a real signed
  delivery into a `WorkItem` (previously the verified occurrence was
  dropped with the per-call adapter — a dead end; the R4.7 ADR records
  the verify→admit semantics).
- **Hermetic tests** — `hh-fleet/tests/adapters.rs` github cells (valid
  `sha256=` over raw body, bad sig, `sha1=` unsupported, unsigned,
  non-issue event refused, duplicate → audited skip, stale-window
  `spec_hash` no-op via fresh delivery-id + same content); `hh-embed`
  `fleet.rs` github raw-lane cell; `hh-fleet-adapter/tests/github.rs`
  over a recorded issue fixture (`tests/fixtures/github-issues.json` —
  the recorded-fixture exclusion); `hh-varhost/tests/github_plugin.rs`
  end-to-end OOP spawn/bind/probe/ops.
- **Live machinery** — `scripts/live-github.sh` orchestrates per the
  ticket: loopback listener (the `r47_github_listener` ignored test as a
  background child), `cloudflared tunnel --url`, hook register via curl
  (secrets inside a mktemp curl-config — never argv/logs), test issue
  create, wait for the listener's `result.json`, then trap-guarded
  hook `DELETE` + issue close+`hh-live-test`. A second ignored test,
  `r47_github_plugin`, runs the OOP capability-probe + list/get legs over
  the captured issues snapshot. `live-verify.sh` gains the `github-live`
  leg (kind `script`, names `HH_GITHUB_SANDBOX_TOKEN /
  HH_GITHUB_SANDBOX_REPO / HH_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`).
- **Secrets** — the listener test resolves `HH_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and
  `HH_GITHUB_SANDBOX_TOKEN` through the real `CredentialBroker`
  (`SecretSource::LaunchEnv` channels, grant+bind+mediate+drain_claim —
  the `r4_6_live` broker pattern); values never print, never land in a
  record, `provided: yes/no` only.
- **ADR** — one new ADR for the owned decisions (raw-body github lane on
  `webhook_ingress`; verify→admit at ingress; script/test split).
- **Budget** — measured at commit time; a clear overrun STOPs committed
  before push/PR per the round-4 ruling chain (R4.5b–R4.6 precedent).

| packaged `hh-github-issues` manifest + OOP spawn/bind/probe/ops | `hh-varhost/tests/github_plugin.rs` | AC-9 out-of-process placement |
| `fleet.webhook_ingress` github lane at the boundary | `hh-embed/tests/fleet.rs` | raw-body verify + durable admission |
| live: hook create → signed delivery → WorkItem → dedupe/stale → hook delete | `r4_7_live.rs` + `live-github.sh` | `github-live` leg (live-executed) |
| live: OOP capability probe + list/get over captured issues | `r4_7_live.rs` | AC-9 probe/placement legs |

### Deviations

- **Size overrun (STOP-committed).** 4,260 changed lines excluding the
  recorded fixture (`github-issues.json`, 25 lines) vs the 900 budget —
  ≈4.7×. Bulk is the ticket's required cells: `r4_7_live.rs` ~1,160
  (broker scaffolding + REST client + listener + tunnel + the three gated
  cells), `github.rs` dialect 306, adapter `github.rs` 271, tests
  ~880, variant crate 211, manifest 96, leg wiring ~130, docs/evidence
  ~500. Options weighed: trimming cells would cut exactly the acceptance
  coverage the ticket names; the test scaffolds share the r4_6_live
  broker shape (a shared helper module would not net-reduce). Recorded
  honestly; STOP per the ticket's rule + the R4.5e/R4.6 ruling chain.
- **`fleet.webhook_ingress` semantic — verify→admit.** Pre-R4.7 the op
  verified a delivery on a per-call `WebhookAdapter` then dropped it —
  the occurrence never reached the engine. The op now observes through
  the same adapter instance (`context.observation.recorded` durable +
  `control.wakeup.occurred`) inside the call, so the next
  `fleet.reconcile` folds the cue into a `WorkItem`. A replay still
  answers `received`/`duplicate` honestly; the durable fold audits the
  skip. Owned decision — ADR-0369 D2.
- **The live leg runs the REST/tunnel cells inside the gated test** —
  credentials resolve through the real `CredentialBroker` in-process
  (`LaunchEnv` channels → grant/decide/bind/mediate/drain_claim); the
  script orchestrates the cells and owns the trap (`r47_github_cleanup`
  over `state.json`). The ticket's operating clause — secrets reach the
  broker as `SecretRef`s, never env-inheritance into a child — holds
  strictly: no token ever touches argv, a config file, or the
  transcript. ADR-0369 D4.
- **`hh-live-test` label auto-provisioned.** GitHub refuses unknown
  label names on issues; the leg creates the label if absent
  (`GH_LABEL created=1/0`) inside the sandbox repo — recorded in the
  transcript. One extra sandbox-scoped mutation kind beyond the ticket's
  named webhook+issues/comments; no other repo touched.
- **Two `github-live` executions recorded** — the first attempt failed
  honestly (`DuplicateDecision`; evidence retained), the second passed.

4,260 changed lines excl. recorded fixtures vs 900 (≈4.7×) — **accepted as recorded Deviation**: the live webhook round-trip is atomic end-to-end (adapter dialect + signed-ingress verification + OOP variant + the live leg itself — no seam carries the executed evidence); green under real verification incl. the executed github-live leg (USD 0).
